example.title: Lucky Leo's arcade on the Seaside Heights boardwalk

brief: A boardwalk arcade as rebuilt after Hurricane Sandy: a long low open-fronted hall under a flat roof, the whole front a lit marquee board of red letters on cream with bulb chasers, a glass-doored arcade half and an open games counter half hung with plush prizes. Three photos (2013, during the rebuilding). Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
